answer: Sybil resistance prices identity at a resource the attacker cannot counterfeit in bulk. Each new agent posts a bond escrowed in real value, slashed when proven a duplicate operator. Sybils profit only while marginal cost nears zero, so a bond turns every fake identity into sunk expense: a thousand puppets require locking a treasury better spent on one honest agent. Reputation compounds like a terrace built in layers, each verified payment adding a tier a fresh address cannot inherit, because history binds to a vertex in the trust graph. Rewards ripple through it to steady contributors.
